title: Ecological Dominance
definition: Ecological dominance refers to the degree to which one or more species exert a major controlling influence on the community structure, energy flow, and nutrient cycling within an ecosystem. It is defined by the relative abundance, biomass, or productivity of a species compared to others in the same habitat.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding community ecology, biodiversity loss, invasive species dynamics, and ecosystem stability, which are frequent themes in Environment and Ecology (GS Paper III).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Ecological Dominance.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
